summary: Smith & Nephew plc via Form 6-K disclosed total issued share capital as of 31 Aug 2026: 877,738,166 ordinary shares including 40,321,038 treasury shares, leaving 837,417,128 voting shares. This is a routine disclosure under FCA's DTR 5.6.1, fulfilling UK transparency obligations. No special situation, transaction, or management change is involved. The filing is a routine corporate notification equivalent to a US capital disclosure. No deal terms or strategic actions are present. What to watch: none — this is strictly informational.
